claims.statement: Adding an acyclic charged macro to the frozen token grammar is conservative and monotone: every old program stays legal with unchanged exact expansion; cyclic dependencies fail closed with RECURSIVE_LIBRARY_CYCLE and no grammar update.
assumptions: frozen {a,b,c} token grammar with concatenation only
macro bodies are sequences over the alphabet at admission time
falsifiers: any corpus program whose expansion changes across an admission
any cyclic library accepted as a grammar update
claims.strongest_parent: standard rewriting/library-learning conservativity; #833 E-line grammar-bias boundary
claims.limits: finite scope; no claim about infinite grammar families or typed languages

claims.statement: The frozen deterministic rule (charged strict-positive corpus compression, syntax-independent tie-break, saturation stop) invents exactly m1 -> a b then m2 -> m1 m1 on the frozen corpus: recursive library formation with acyclic DAG and exact base-word semantics, re-derived by an independent oracle.
assumptions: training corpus is successful programs only
charges: definition cost |body| symbols + maintenance kappa per macro
falsifiers: admission of a zero-gain candidate (hostile HZERO-1)
claims.strongest_parent: DreamCoder/Stitch corpus-compression abstraction admission; #233 HST-T05 lifecycle charges
claims.limits: one corpus, two generations; no claim that this rule is optimal (g2-acquisition-economics parent shows compression selectors can fail utility argmax elsewhere)

claims.statement: On 12 frozen-before-invention reuse-positive held-out targets, cumulative exact breadth-by-length discovery burden drops from 50,052 to 1,307 with K_total=6 charged (net -48,739, strict); the lifecycle identity H_eff*Delta > K holds exactly per macro and in aggregate; the unrelated control preserves a +1,178 charged regression; 0/200 equal-size random-admission nulls beat the true library.
assumptions: held-out sets frozen before invention and disjoint at task level
burden metric counts every enumerated program including macro programs
horizon = one pass over the frozen held-out suite at kappa=1
falsifiers: any null library with net < true net
claims.strongest_parent: #233 HST-T04 allocation compounding; h1-amortized chain (charges and alphabet-widening cost); g2-utility-gated (held-out utility evidence)
claims.limits: existence/conditional finite transfer at the registered fixture scope only; explicitly not PRIMITIVE_INVENTION_ALWAYS_HELPS, not universal, not real-world transfer; short targets can individually regress (burden metric punishes widened prefixes), the aggregate and the control carry the claim
